dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「困ったな……今朝はなかなか起きてくれない」
dialogues.en:
"What should I do......? He isn't waking up this
morning......"
dialogues.text:
"What should I do......? He isn't waking up this
morning......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
"It's already the time he needs to wake up...... What should
I do......?"
dialogues.text:
"It's already the time he needs to wake up...... What should
I do......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも……そんな事……していいのかしら？」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
（んん？　何だ？　この感触……。柔らかい
　……）
dialogues.en: (Mmmm? What......? What is this touch...... It's so soft...)
dialogues.text: (Mmmm? What......? What is this touch...... It's so soft...)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
（それに、何だろうな……？　香水のような、
　いい匂いが……）
dialogues.en:
(And what's this......? It smells nice, like a
perfume......)
dialogues.text:
(And what's this......? It smells nice, like a
perfume......)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （あ……離れていっちゃった……どこに……？）
dialogues.en: (Ah...... it went away...... where did it go......?)
dialogues.text: (Ah...... it went away...... where did it go......?)

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんだった。顔が真っ赤だ。口元を手で｛おお／覆｝っ
ているのが、妙に目につく。
dialogues.en:
It's Yoriko. Her face is red and she's covering her mouth
with her hand.
dialogues.text:
It's Yoriko. Her face is red and she's covering her mouth
with her hand.

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましを止めつつ、｛かたわ／側｝らの頼子さんを見ると、
何かの魔法をかけられたように、カチカチになっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
Her entire body's stiff like a rock, as if she's been
enchanted.
dialogues.text:
Her entire body's stiff like a rock, as if she's been
enchanted.

dialogues.jp: しゅいしゅいと、スウェーして避ける。
dialogues.en: I dodge to the right and to the left.
dialogues.text: I dodge to the right and to the left.

dialogues.jp:
髪の毛の先に重しがついていたら、立派な武器
になりそうな程、ぶんぶんと首を振ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
She's shaking her head from side to side so hard that if she
had metal on the end of her hair, it could have been a
strong weapon.
dialogues.text:
She's shaking her head from side to side so hard that if she
had metal on the end of her hair, it could have been a
strong weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お、おはようございます。そ、それじゃ」

口の中でむにゃむにゃ呟くと、逃げるように部
屋を出ていった。
dialogues.en:
She mumbles, and leaves my room as if she was running away
from something.
dialogues.text:
She mumbles, and leaves my room as if she was running away
from something.

dialogues.jp:
何なんだ？　首を傾げつつも朝の仕度を始める。
今朝は、少し寝過ごしたらしい。
dialogues.en:
What was that about? Tilting my head in question, I start to
get ready. I think I overslept a little bit this morning.
dialogues.text:
What was that about? Tilting my head in question, I start to
get ready. I think I overslept a little bit this morning.

dialogues.jp:
シャツに腕を通しながら、ふと、口元に何かの
感触が残っている事に気がついた。
dialogues.en:
As I put my shirt on, I notice there's a touch left on my
lips.
dialogues.text:
As I put my shirt on, I notice there's a touch left on my
lips.

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、失われた感触を求めて、目が覚めた
はず。そして、向けた目の先には頼子さんが。
dialogues.en:
I remember that I woke up trying to find the touch that had
moved away from me. And when I opened my eyes, there was
Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
I remember that I woke up trying to find the touch that had
moved away from me. And when I opened my eyes, there was
Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp: より正確には、頼子さんの唇が。
dialogues.en: To be more specific, it was her lips in front of my face.
dialogues.text: To be more specific, it was her lips in front of my face.

dialogues.jp: １と１を足してみる。その答えは──。

「……魔法をかけられたのは俺だったか。石化
　じゃないけれど」
dialogues.en: "......Was it me myself who was enchanted?"
dialogues.text: "......Was it me myself who was enchanted?"

dialogues.jp:
何かの熱病を心配させるほどに、頼子さんの顔
は赤い。
dialogues.en:
Her face is so red that it makes me worry if she's sick with
high fever.
dialogues.text:
Her face is so red that it makes me worry if she's sick with
high fever.

dialogues.jp:
さっきから、パンには手をつけずにコーヒーば
かりを飲んでいる。
dialogues.en:
I've been drinking coffee and not even touching bread
because if I eat something, I think the touch left on my
lips could disappear.
dialogues.text:
I've been drinking coffee and not even touching bread
because if I eat something, I think the touch left on my
lips could disappear.

dialogues.jp: 食べると、感触が消えそうで……。

dialogues.en: I can't leave it like this. This is a big thing to me.
dialogues.text: I can't leave it like this. This is a big thing to me.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱりうやむやにはしておけないな。俺にとっ
ては、重大な出来事だぞ。
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, I want to ask you something."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, I want to ask you something."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「頼子さんさ、もしかして、朝に──」

キス｛ぎごく／疑獄｝はあっさりと──でもないが──否定
された。
dialogues.en:
She easily --well, not quite-- denied the allegation about
the kiss.
dialogues.text:
She easily --well, not quite-- denied the allegation about
the kiss.

dialogues.jp:
否定した時のあまりのアセアセぶりは怪しかっ
たが、ともかく言葉では否定された。
dialogues.en:
She reacted very suspiciously when she denied it, but her
words were clearly ones of denial.
dialogues.text:
She reacted very suspiciously when she denied it, but her
words were clearly ones of denial.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、彼女がキスをする理由もないしな……。
　はあ……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's true that there's no reason for her to kiss
me... Sigh."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's true that there's no reason for her to kiss
me... Sigh."

dialogues.jp:
｛せんさい／繊細｝なはずのため息が、なぜか大きなあくびに
コンバートしてしまう。
dialogues.en:
It was supposed to be a very sensitive sigh but somehow it
turned into a yawn.
dialogues.text:
It was supposed to be a very sensitive sigh but somehow it
turned into a yawn.

dialogues.jp:
二日も続けて夢を見せられたせいで、睡魔の戦
闘力がスカウターぎりぎりだ。
dialogues.en:
Since I've been forced to have dreams for two days in a row,
I have no power left to fight off sleep.
dialogues.text:
Since I've been forced to have dreams for two days in a row,
I have no power left to fight off sleep.

dialogues.jp:
学園で。半分眠ったような頭で、てくてくと寝
床へ向かう。
dialogues.en:
...at school. I'm half-asleep as I walk to 'my bed', as I
like to call my desk at school.
dialogues.text:
...at school. I'm half-asleep as I walk to 'my bed', as I
like to call my desk at school.

dialogues.jp:
日射病のように視界が白くかすむ。勝手知った
る道なので、歩く事は出来るが……。
dialogues.en:
It's like having sunstroke -- my vision's blurry and white.
I can still keep walking because I know this road, but......
dialogues.text:
It's like having sunstroke -- my vision's blurry and white.
I can still keep walking because I know this road, but......

dialogues.jp: あ……身体が宙に舞う感覚。そして──、
dialogues.en: Ah...... My body is flying through the air. And......
dialogues.text: Ah...... My body is flying through the air. And......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あんな事……しちゃうなんて……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "No! M-My face is so hot again......"
dialogues.text: "No! M-My face is so hot again......"

dialogues.jp:
……起こしに来てくれた頼子さんに、キスをさ
れたような、でも本人に真っ赤な顔で否定され
てしまった。

少々意気消沈しながら登校。二日続けて夢を見
せられたせいで眠くてしょうがない

ふらふらと歩いていると突然、衝撃と体が宙に
まう感覚に襲われたのだった。
